name: Myotonic Dystrophy
definition: Multisystem genetic disorder characterized by myotonia, progressive weakness and potential cardiac, respiratory, endocrine and ocular complications.

investigations.principle: Genetic testing confirms diagnosis; ECG/cardiac and respiratory surveillance are essential.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Anesthesia and sedative risk requires special planning.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Vata-stambha phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Multisystem genetic disorder characterized by myotonia, progressive weakness and potential cardiac, respiratory, endocrine and ocular complications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
